name: Christmas
description: A winter night: stars, a moon, northern lights, mountains and pines, snow falling in three depths, and a house strung with lights with smoke from its chimney and now and then Santa looking out of it. Candy-cane stripes, icicles and snow on the page; presents, a snowman, a gingerbread man, Santa's sleigh and shooting stars. A finished scan blazes every bulb. An unknown new device is a burglar on the naughty list, and the night turns red.
author: BAMF
